Karina (PM): Quick sync — we need a rollout plan for the smart-routing feature next sprint. Requirements: staged regions, canary cohorts, an A/B quality check, and enterprise opt-ins. Who can own the safety gates and telemetry?

Matt (Eng Lead): I can take canary infra and rollout scripts. Suggest cohorts: 0.5% (smoke), 5% (small canary), 25% (load), 100% (full). 24h bake per step by default, with manual approval between 25% -> 100%.

Sasha (SRE): +1 on cohorts. Add a warmup window (10m) before counting errors for the first two steps so caches/KV are populated. Pre-provision capacity for region ramps >=25% to avoid cold-start spikes.

Leo (Product Ops): Gating criteria proposal: block rollout if any of these occur during a step:
- p99 latency increase > 20% over baseline
- error rate multiplier > 1.5x baseline OR absolute errors > 2%
- quality regression: A/B metric drop > 1.5% (see Amanda)
Also require an explicit owner for each cohort and a kill-switch contact list.

Maya (CS): Heads up — customer ACME requires opt-in for their tenants and a custom rollback plan. We need a channel to notify customers pre-rollout and a per-tenant holdback flag.

Amanda (Data): For the A/B quality check, we should run live evals against a labeled prompt set and track: exact-match, coherence score, and hallucination rate. Gate if any metric degrades beyond configured thresholds for 2 consecutive windows (30m windows). I can produce the eval harness and dashboards.

Matt (Eng Lead): Implementation detail: feature-flag config (example):
```json
{"flag_name":"smart-routing","variants":["control","variantA"],"cohorts":[{"pct":0.5,"regions":["us-west","eu-central"]},{"pct":5,"regions":["us-west","eu-central","ap-south"]},{"pct":25,"regions":["*"]},{"pct":100,"regions":["*"]}],"gates":{"latency_pct":20,"error_multiplier":1.5},"kill_switch":"rollout.disable.smart-routing"}
```
We should deploy the flag config via the flags service and smoke test the canary route with curl: `curl -H 'x-tenant: acme' https://api.redwood.example/v1/route -d '{"prompt":"..."}'`

Sasha (SRE): Also create a traffic-split fallback policy: if circuit trips, route traffic to model-legacy variant and send alerts to #eng-oncall + oncall pager. Add automatic rollback if error spike persists > 10m after circuit trip.

Karina (PM): Timeline: start staged rollout Monday morning. Tasks: Matt (canary infra + scripts), Amanda (eval dashboards + thresholds), Sasha (capacity + circuit-breaker), Leo (ops checklist + customer comms), Maya (customer opt-in list). Can we have a dry-run this Friday?

Matt (Eng Lead): Dry-run Friday looks good. I'll push a staging flag and run a 0.5% smoke across regions. Will post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-03-27T15:00Z for flag smart-routing (staging). :rocket:

Leo (Product Ops): I'll draft the rollout-playbook doc and the kill-switch runbook, pinging legal for any customer notice language. Will share a checklist link here once ready.

Amanda (Data): I'll wire the eval alerts to PagerDuty and add a short-form dashboard for the PM on-call to glance at during bakes.

Maya (CS): I'll reach out to ACME and get their opt-in confirmation and contact for post-rollout monitoring.

Karina (PM): Great — thanks everyone. Callout: keep A/B buckets seeded by tenant hash so we don't split a single tenant across buckets unless explicitly allowed.
